name: Omari
author: bergdahlchi
description: You like the Niri wayland compositor but don't want to leave the cool world of Omarchy. Omari adds Niri-inspired scrolling, gestures, Workspace overview and Alt-Tab switcher of course styled with your Omarchy theme.
